title.en: Machine Learning for Tabular Data: Baselines and Validation
title.ar: تعلّم الآلة للبيانات الجدولية: خطوط الأساس والتحقق من الصحة

tagline: Take a tabular prediction from the decision it serves to a model card: a logged baseline ladder, validation that mirrors use, a leakage audit, a threshold that fits capacity and errors by subgroup with intervals
description: Participants predict which trainees of a fictional vocational training fund are likely not to complete, so that advisers can offer support early. On synthetic enrolment data with repeated trainees and cohorts, they climb a baseline ladder to tuned gradient-boosted trees, test an automated or pretrained challenger, choose validation that mirrors use, audit for leakage, set a threshold, break errors down by subgroup and write a model card. Deployment is left to AE-205 and AE-305.
audience: Practitioners. Graduates and early-career analysts who have completed the FN courses or passed the placement test, and analysts moving into data science.
prerequisites: FN-101 Python for Data and AI Work
FN-103 Mathematics for Machine Learning: Vectors, Gradients and Probability
FN-105 How Machine Learning and Language Models Work
Joins and groups tables with a dataframe library
Explains overfitting and the purpose of a held-out set

outcomes.text: Identify the leakage type and the fitting validation scheme in short tabular modelling cases, given six described problems and their data-collection process
outcomes.evidence: a table naming the leak and the scheme for each, at least five of six correct

outcomes.text: Apply a baseline ladder from a constant predictor to tuned gradient-boosted trees, logging every run, given identical folds and a fixed tuning budget
outcomes.evidence: a run log with score and fold spread per rung

outcomes.text: Implement validation that matches the data structure and measure how far a random split overstates performance, given repeated trainees across five yearly cohorts
outcomes.evidence: random, grouped and time-ordered scores with the gap explained

outcomes.text: Test an automated or pretrained challenger against the tuned model under identical folds and time budget, given the champion model and a challenger configuration
outcomes.evidence: a paired comparison over folds with an interval and a one-line decision

outcomes.text: Analyse calibration, the decision threshold and held-out errors by subgroup, with intervals that reflect slice size, given predictions joined to region, gender, age band and provider, and adviser capacity
outcomes.evidence: a calibration plot, a threshold with its precision and recall, and a subgroup error table

outcomes.text: Build a validated tabular model from framing to model card and defend its validation scheme and limits, given a synthetic case or an approved public tabular problem
outcomes.evidence: a public repository with run log, leakage audit, subgroup results and model card, defended live

case_study.name: Sullam Vocational Training Fund
case_study.summary: Sullam Vocational Training Fund is a fictional fund that pays for vocational programmes at 60 training providers in 13 regions. Participants work on 45,000 synthetic enrolments of 30,000 trainees over five yearly cohorts to build Mubakkir, a score that at the end of week 2 puts the trainees most likely not to complete on an adviser's list. All data are synthetic, written with a fixed seed, with repeated trainees, cohort drift, four planted leaks and registers that under-record absence in two regions.

days.title: Capstone: a validated tabular model and its defence
days.subtitle: Each participant defends a tabular model from framing to model card in eight minutes, including one change the assessor asks for

capstone.summary: A tabular problem from a shortlist of synthetic and public cases taken from framing to model card, in a public repository whose README reports the baseline ladder, validation, leakage audit, threshold, subgroup errors and a paired comparison; eight-minute defence
capstone.submission: A link to a public GitHub repository: the code with a fixed seed and a lock file, the run log, the leakage audit, the subgroup results and the model card, and a README that reports the baseline ladder, the validation scheme, the leakage audit, the threshold, errors by subgroup and a paired comparison; prompts and agent transcripts are committed with it
